meta.title: Approver approves a budget (with optional remarks); workflow moves to the next approver
gaps: Verify the specific next approver in the sequence is shown as pending

steps.note: Open the prepared budget approval proposal.
Open the Approvals tab containing the budget's Approval Note.
Confirm the budget approval note is available for review.
Confirm the optional remarks field is present before approval.
Submit approval as the pending first approver; this performs the approval action and records the workflow result.
Confirm the workflow remains in approval progress after this approval is submitted.
